Capt & Co. - final build folder
================================
CaptCo-linux-x86_64.zip     Linux x86_64   (run ./CaptCo.x86_64)
CaptCo-windows-x86_64.zip   Windows x86_64 (run CaptCo.exe)
CaptCo-macos-universal.zip  macOS universal (Intel + Apple Silicon .app, ad-hoc signed - right-click > Open)
CaptCo-web.zip              Web: unzip and serve statically (landing page index.html + play/)
CaptCo-r36s-arm64.zip       R36S / R36H handheld (Linux ARM64, 640x480, low-spec preset) - see docs/R36S.md
pocket/captco.gb            Pocket Edition, Game Boy (4 shades)
pocket/captco.gbc           Pocket Edition, Game Boy Color
pocket/captco_pocket.gba    Pocket Edition, Game Boy Advance (also runs on R36S/R36H built-in emulator)
docs/                       PLAY_GUIDE.md, R36S.md, FLASHING.md, PLAN.md
Verified vs unverified status: see the top-level README.md in the repository.
